slides.texte_overlay:
11 places you should stay
silent at all costs

1. Be silent in a church
or a temple - respect
what others hold sacred.

2. Be silent in a hospital
hallway - someone is having
the worst day of their life.

3. Be silent in a library -
some people are building
their future.

4. Be silent in a museum -
let the art talk.

5. Be silent when your boss
is being criticized - loyalty
is tested in rooms.

6. Be silent when a friend
tells a story you know -
let him have it.

7. Be silent in the group chat
when you're angry.

8. Be silent when the topic is
new to you - listen, then
learn it.
slides.texte_sophia:
8. Be silent when the topic is
new to you - then use a
micro-learning app like
the Sophia app.

slides.texte_overlay:
9. Be silent when someone
is finally opening up.

10. Be silent when you can't
add anything kind.

11. Be silent when you've
already won - no need
to prove it.
